cohort: 35 consecutive patients with symptomatic isthmocele at Hospital Piero Palagi in Florence, Italy, between 2010 and 2015
finding: Patients with isthmocele who experienced infertility had a higher number of previous cesarean sections, a higher grade of isthmocele, and a higher body mass index compared to fertile patients.
mod_finding: This study investigated the prevalence of infertility in patients with isthmocele, a uterine diverticulum often formed at the site of a cesarean delivery scar.
